name: Hotel Bogner
beschreibung: The Hotel Bogner welcomes guests to a sunny, peaceful setting on Walburga Schindl-Straße 21 in Absam, situated right at the entrance to the dramatic Halltal Valley at the foot of the towering Karwendel mountain range. This distinguished, traditional four-star country inn features stylish rooms and suites styled in fine Tyrolean woodwork, equipped with contemporary en-suite bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi, and private balconies presenting wide views across the Inn Valley and alpine summits. Following active hours outdoors, the on-site wellness oasis with Finnish sauna, steam room, and quiet relaxation area invites guests to unwind. The acclaimed restaurant treats diners to award-winning Tyrolean culinary classics and Austrian specialities crafted from regional produce. The historic salt-mining town of Hall in Tirol and Innsbruck's historic landmarks like the Golden Roof are reached within minutes. In summer, scenic trails into the Karwendel Nature Park begin right at the hotel, while winter offers skiing at Glungezer and Nordkette.
kurzbeschreibung: Four-star country hotel on Walburga Schindl-Straße in Absam near Innsbruck featuring saunas and close to the Karwendel Nature Park.
